answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 168657 Country: India Title: Meaning of my daughter name Question: We have a 5 years old daughter whose name is Anaya Hareem. We want to know the exact meaning of this name and whether we can keep this name? Also my second daughter is 4 months old and we request to suggest a suitable name for her. Answer ID: 168657 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 664/571/H=06/1440) (1) The name Inaya Hareem is good. Inaya means care, benefaction and concern. Hareem means respectable. (2) For the second daughter choose any name among the names: Aisha, Zainab, Umm Kulsum, Ruqayya, Umm Salma, Umm Sulaim, Rashida, Sayeeda, Atika, Majida etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
